sql_templates.description: Query to retrieve the latest VCP picks with strong fundamentals.
sql_templates.name: latest_vcp_fundamentals
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_vcp AS (
    SELECT 
        vcp.symbol, 
        vcp.price, 
        ss.enhanced_fund_score, 
        ss.stage 
    FROM 
        scores.stage2_vcp_picks vcp 
    JOIN 
        scores.stage_snapshots ss 
    ON 
        vcp.symbol = ss.symbol 
    WHERE 
        vcp.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
        AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
        AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
        AND ss.enhanced_fund_score > 8 
    ORDER BY 
        ss.enhanced_fund_score DESC, 
        vcp.vcp_score DESC
    LIMIT 50
) 
SELECT 
    symbol, 
    price, 
    enhanced_fund_score, 
    stage 
FROM 
    latest_vcp;

synthesis_guidance: ['Prioritize high fundamental scores and VCP quality.', 'Use trading signals to enhance selection.']
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 0814

sql_templates.description: Fetch the latest market context combining FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index data.
sql_templates.name: latest_market_context
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_date AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) as max_date FROM market.index_eod),
latest_flows AS (
    SELECT * FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date)
),
latest_regime AS (
    SELECT * FROM signals.regime_history
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date)
),
latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT * FROM breadth.market_daily
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date)
),
latest_index AS (
    SELECT * FROM market.index_eod
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date)
)
SELECT 
    f.trade_date, 
    f.flow_signal, 
    r.regime, 
    b.ad_signal, 
    i.index_symbol, 
    i.change_pct
FROM latest_flows f
JOIN latest_regime r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN latest_breadth b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN latest_index i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
WHERE i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50';

synthesis_guidance: ['Summarize the current market regime influenced by FII/DII flows and breadth.', 'Highlight any conflict or alignment between breadth signals and regime.']
title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 0820

sql_templates.description: Fetch the latest insider alerts and bulk deals with technical confirmation for the last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.name: insider_deal_alerts
sql_templates.template:
WITH recent_insider_alerts AS (
    SELECT 
        ia.symbol, ia.alert_date, ia.alert_type, ia.entity, ia.qty, ia.value_cr, ia.insider_score,
        bb.deal_date, bb.deal_type, bb.qty AS deal_qty, bb.price, bb.side, ss.stage, ss.technical_score
    FROM 
        signals.insider_alerts ia
    JOIN 
        signals.bulk_block_deals bb ON ia.symbol = bb.symbol
    JOIN 
        scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ia.symbol = ss.symbol
    WHERE 
        ia.alert_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
        AND bb.deal_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
        AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
        AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
)
SELECT * FROM recent_insider_alerts
ORDER BY insider_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: ['Focus on stocks with strong insider activity and corroborating bulk deals.', 'Prioritize entities with high insider scores and positive trading signals.', 'Provide a watchlist format for ease of action identification.']
